component.name: FileCommander
文件指挥官
檔案指揮官
component.summary: Powerful dual-pane file manager for advanced users
面向高级用户的强大双栏文件管理器

description.p: A powerful dual-pane file manager inspired by Total Commander and developed from scratch. It efficiently manages local files, conveniently uses network file services, previews many file types, and is an efficiency tool for advanced users.
文件指挥官（FileCommander）是受 Total Commander 启发、从头开发的功能强大的 双栏文件管理器。它可以高效管理本地文件，方便地使用网络文件服务，预览多种文件内容， 是一款专门为高级用户准备的效率工具。
